why: C2: claims a tag can lack its hint when no statement is load-bearing. The tag renders only when statement.load_bearing is true, and then answer.statements.some(load_bearing) is true, so the hint is always rendered whenever any tag is; with no load-bearing statement there is no tag to describe. The test "shows the hint on a result only when a statement is load-bearing" covers both cases.

C3: says hiding system and user from the readable llm input goes beyond the goal. It is part of the readable view: both fields are already shown as System prompt and User message directly above the Input box, the Show raw JSON toggle still has them exactly, and the reviewed test commit baf49da specifies it (test 'does not repeat an llm span's prompts in its readable input'). Repeating them would also break the existing getByText('SYSTEM PROMPT TEXT') test, which needs the prompt to appear once.
